diagnoses.description: The bundle documented graph construction but did not provide a reusable parse_script entry point for converting dialogue text into the graph representation. Add that entry point while retaining the existing graph data structures.

The skill lacked a deterministic, executable offline audit path that always produces the required CSV when the preferred scanner or its offline database is unavailable. Provide a local scanner/fallback workflow and stable CSV generation instead of ending without an artifact.

The segment-combination guidance did not robustly normalize overlapping or out-of-bound silence intervals before downstream processing. The repair adds overlap merging, boundary clamping, and matching documentation so the pipeline has well-formed segments.

Scripts intended for direct checkout execution relied on package imports that were not resolvable from their script paths. Make the bundle self-contained for direct execution and avoid unnecessary third-party TSV-processing dependencies.

The translation guidance did not require a mechanical check that the Scala module preserves the Python public API and avoids common Scala 2.13 compile hazards. Add a required-symbol inventory and static compile-hygiene checklist.

locations.section: Build an explicit required symbol list
